observations.winner_drift: Twenty-session equal weighting reduced wealth versus buy-and-hold in all three scopes, so routine rebalancing is not the passive alpha source.
observations.drawdown: Common-five maximum drawdown was concentrated in its three optical winners; union and leader-removal maximum drawdowns were broad.
observations.old_evidence: Recovered causal research status confirms old passive guard, benchmark-faithful ownership guard, cash sleeves, trend rotation, record-high and reversal families were already measured and did not jointly pass.

limitations: This is retrospective attribution. It justifies one prospective fixed structure but is not evidence that sector campaign ownership will improve wealth.
